# Weekly delivery status — template v1

Header: approved Vercel/Turas branding, customer, engagement, reporting week and
timezone, as-of time, delivery owner, recipients/classification and report version.

1. **Executive summary:** outcome and current delivery state, change since last week,
   key decision needed. Health must have a cited rationale and allow “unknown.”
2. **Completed and accepted:** dated log entries, deliverables and customer acceptance;
   distinguish work performed from accepted milestones.
3. **Next week:** planned activities, accountable owners, due dates and dependencies.
4. **Milestones and scope:** baseline versus forecast, change requests and impact.
5. **Risks, issues and decisions:** impact, mitigation, owner, due date and escalation.
6. **Effort and capacity:** approved actual versus plan, remaining estimate and
   staffing constraints. Omit internal rates/margins from customer/partner versions.
7. **Customer actions and outcomes:** requested decisions, adoption/measurement
   progress and handoff readiness, with explicit gaps.
8. **Source and review footer:** log cutoff, source versions, late/missing entries,
   reviewer, approval and link to the immutable report record.

No logs means “no validated update available,” not “on track.” Use separate audience
projections for customers, account teams and leadership. Generate a draft each week;
send only after explicit review or under an authorized recurring policy. Record
recipient-set version, timezone/cadence, exact report digest, attempts and receipts.
Deduplicate by engagement + period + audience + publication version. Corrections
create a labeled new publication rather than silently re-sending the original.
